title: Iran Marks Revolution by Parading Coffins of US Commanders
description: With a highly provocative display aimed directly at the United States, staging a public spectacle in which mock coffins bearing the names of senior U.S. military leaders were paraded, Iran's ruling regime marked its 47th anniversary of the Islamic Revolution on Wednesday.

title: Fmr Israeli Amb. to Newsmax: Likelihood Iran Accepts US Demands 'Very, Very Low'
description: The likelihood of Iran accepting sweeping U.S. demands amid escalating tensions is very, very low, former Israeli Ambassador to the United States Michael Herzog told Newsmax, warning that diplomacy may falter if both sides remain entrenched.

title: Trump Repeats 'Midnight Hammer' Warning For Iran After Meeting Netanyahu
description: Trump warned Iran of consequences if it fails to strike a nuclear deal with the United States.

title: Trump says he insisted to Netanyahu that US negotiations with Iran continue
description: President Donald Trump said he insisted to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during their White House meeting Wednesday that negotiations with Iran continue as the United States pushes for a nuclear deal with Tehran. There was nothing definitive reached other than I insisted that negotiations with Iran continue to see whether or not a Deal can be consummated.

title: Exclusive: Big pro-Khamenei rally at Tehran's iconic Azadi Square amid US tensions
description: Thousands gathered at Tehran’s Azadi Square to mark the 47th anniversary of the 1979 Iranian Revolution, showcasing strong pro-regime mobilisation. The massive turnout comes amid heightened tensions between Iran, the United States and Israel.

title: Iran Signals Openness to Nuclear Inspections as U.S. Warships Mass in the Gulf
description: Iran’s president offered international nuclear inspections as the United States expanded its military presence and tightened sanctions following stalled talks and a violent domestic crackdown.

title: Iran rules out broader U.S. talks as Trump hints at sending 2nd carrier
description: Iran insisted Wednesday that it was willing to negotiate with the United States over its nuclear program, but it ruled out broader talks at a pivotal moment in diplomacy between Washington and Tehran

title: Iran's President Asserts Nation Will Not Succumb to Excessive Demands
description: The negotiations between Iran and the United States, which recently recommenced after a period of heightened conflict, will focus primarily on Iran's nuclear program.

title: Iran warns US not to be swayed by Netanyahu ahead of talks
description: Iran has warned the United States against allowing Israel to influence its foreign policy, as tensions persist ahead of renewed diplomatic engagements. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Ismail Bag…

title: “We do not want nuclear weapons, we are open to any inspection,” says the President of Iran
description: The Iranian president stressed that his country “will not bow to excessive demands” following the resumption of contacts with the United States
